entries.title: Your last message and Firstmate's reply now read as quotes
entries.body: The two lines above the message box now sit inside quotation marks, and Firstmate's reply is the same size as your message, so a short reply such as "Got it" reads as something said rather than a button. Neither line is a link any more: a click does nothing, and Tab passes over them. Resting the pointer on a line that is cut short shows its whole text, and Activity still keeps every message.

picture.alt: Your message "cut another alpha once the checks pass" and under it Firstmate's reply "Got it", each in quotation marks and the same size, centered just above the message box
